result.reason: The clause includes the preferred six-month transition period, then-current rates, machine-readable export, deletion, and written certification. However, it makes the 30-day export period run from Customer’s request rather than expiry or termination, so it does not fully reach the stated position. It also requires return and deletion of all Customer data upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment, potentially affecting data needed for other active attachments and conflicting with the original clause’s preservation of those arrangements. The language should limit attachment-level obligations to the data associated with the terminated attachment and measure the export deadline from expiry or termination.
